mgmt_bio.text: John Fieldly has been with Celsius Holdings since 2012, serving as chief financial officer before being named chief executive in 2018, and he now holds the roles of chairman and CEO. His finance background made him an unusual choice to lead a consumer goods company, where the top job typically goes to brand or sales executives. Much of the leadership team around him came from Pepsi, including COO Eric Hanson, who spent 27 years there in sales, general management, commercial planning and partnership management, and Celsius International President Garrett Quigley, who spent more than 25 years at Pepsi managing relationships with franchise bottlers across 120 markets. Under his direction, capital allocation priorities center on integrating Alani Nu and Rockstar, paying down acquisition debt, reinvesting in marketing and international expansion, and buybacks.
